customManagers.description: Swift releases. swiftlang/swift tags them swift-X.Y.Z-RELEASE; pins.env holds the bare version and derives the tag, the download URL and the mirrored asset name from it.
The swiftlang/llvm-project commit the build support is cut from. Branch and digest are captured together so the branch stays authoritative in pins.env rather than being duplicated here.

packageRules.description: A Swift version bump is NOT self-contained: TOOLCHAIN_SHA256 is the hash of a 1.5 GB binary Renovate never downloads, so the PR is correct except for that line and mirror-toolchain.sh fails closed on it. Never automerge this one -- it needs a human to paste the hash the failure prints. The shared preset's automerge (with ignoreTests) would otherwise land a broken main.
